name: Contracts

subjectOf.text: Residual loss arises because the cost of enforcing suboptimal contracts between principals and agents always exceeds the benefits of performing the contractual obligations.
subjectOf.abstract: Residual loss arises because the cost of enforcing suboptimal contracts between principals and agents always exceed the benefits of performing the contractual obligations.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393

subjectOf.text: Renegotiating contracts every time the currency's value changes is expensive and continually and randomly punishes at least one of the contracting parties.
subjectOf.abstract: Renegotiating contracts whenever the currency changes is expensive, and continually and randomly punishes at least one of the parties.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
scope_conditions: contracts denominated in a fluctuating currency

subjectOf.text: A decentralized economy requires stable cryptocurrencies, because renegotiating contracts every time a currency's value changes is inefficient and continually punishes one of the parties.
subjectOf.abstract: Renegotiating contracts each time the value of a currency changes is inefficient, and continually punishes one of the parties. The economy should not be founded on gambling, so any future decentralized economy requires stable cryptocurrencies.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
